General hosting and deployment research for the MainzWare roadmap.

When populated, keep recommendations concise and sourced. Evaluate managed PostgreSQL, object storage for receipt images, durable background-job/queue hosting for OCR, and horizontal API scaling against the current product roadmap rather than only today's deployment.

Project-specific live infrastructure facts belong in `.github/agents/knowledgebase/` or the relevant product/service documentation.
